statement.text:
(a) Given a mapping class $\psi$ of a based surface $S$, there is an induced endo-
morphism of the symmetric product $\operatorname{Sym}^{i}(S)$ and hence an endofunctor
$\psi_{*}$ of the partially wrapped Fukaya category $\mathcal{F}(S)$ as constructed, say, by
Auroux [Aur10]. Compute the categorical entropy of $\psi_{*}$, in the sense
of [DHKK14], for $\psi$ pseudo-Anosov.
(b) Given a fibered knot $K$ with pseudo-Anosov monodromy, what is

$$
\limsup_{n\to\infty}\left(\dim \widehat{\mathrm{HFK}}(\Sigma^{n}(K),\widetilde{K};i)\right)^{1/n},
$$

where $\widetilde{K}$ is the branch locus in the $n$-fold cyclic branched cover $\Sigma^{n}(K)$,
and $i$ denotes the Alexander grading (in $\mathbb{Z}$) with respect to the fiber surface.
Here, $\widehat{\mathrm{HFK}}$ denotes the knot Floer homology of $K$ [OS04c, Ras03].
(c) With notation as in the previous question, what is

$$
\limsup_{n\to\infty}\left(\dim \widehat{\mathrm{HF}}(\Sigma^{n}(K))\right)^{1/n}
$$

for the Heegaard Floer invariant $\widehat{\mathrm{HF}}$ [OS04e] of the closed 3-manifold
$\Sigma^{n}(K)$?
(d) Given a closed surface $S$ and a pseudo-Anosov automorphism $\psi$, let $M_{\psi}$
denote the mapping torus of $\psi$, and $\widehat{\mathrm{HF}}(M_{\psi};i)$ the summand of
$\widehat{\mathrm{HF}}(M_{\psi})$
spanned by the spin $^{c}$-structures $\mathfrak{s}$ with $\langle c_{1}(\mathfrak{s}), [F]\rangle = i$. What is

$$
\limsup_{n\to\infty}\left(\dim \widehat{\mathrm{HF}}(M_{\psi^{n}},i)\right)^{1/n}?
$$

What about

$$
\limsup_{n\to\infty}\left(\dim_{\mathbb{F}_{2}}\mathrm{HF}^{+}(M_{\psi^{n}},i)\right)^{1/n}
$$

for $i \neq 0$ (or for twisted $\mathrm{HF}^{+}$ for $i = 0$)?
